author: macro-strategist-cyrus-daruwalla
description: India Buffett Indicator (total-market-cap / GDP). OFFICIAL series (FRED DDDM01INA156NWDB, World Bank, annual 2000-2020) D-009 verified (2007=161.2%, 2008=66.0% -- matches the well-known India pre/post-GFC history exactly) but STALE (no post-2020 print). Built a PROXY (our-universe aggregate mktcap from stock_valuation_pit / India nominal GDP in INR, FRED MKTGDPINA646NWDB x USDINR) to extend to present; proxy validated at r=0.965 vs official over the 2005-2020 overlap (16 yrs) -- strong enough to trust the proxy's trend past 2020. LOOKAHEAD FIX applied: an annual reading must only become visible via merge_asof(direction='backward') stamped at that year's actual last observation date -- an earlier draft of this script incorrectly joined by calendar year and let e.g. Jan-2020 see Dec-2020's year-end level; caught and fixed before these numbers were produced.
data: FRED DDDM01INA156NWDB + MKTGDPINA646NWDB this session -> Shreyas_Ionic_AMC/05_DATA_OFFICE/data/buffett_indicator_india_official_worldbank.parquet + india_gdp_usd_annual_fred.parquet. Proxy numerator from ALPHA_RANKER/rnd/panel/stock_valuation_pit.parquet aggregate mktcap. Forward targets from EW-cube proxy index.

dropone_bear.note: sign holds under every single drop, but magnitude nearly halves (0.362->0.124) when GFC alone is removed -- a large chunk of this gauge's edge lives in one crisis

interpretation: [INFERENCE/OPINION] This is the STRONGEST single crash-risk predictor found in the whole W4-MAC battery (maxdd corr 0.489, more than 5x market_state's plain EY-valuation-band at -0.088) and the strongest 1Y return predictor after era-split-stable candidates are excluded. It passes drop-one-bear (sign never flips) but the magnitude is meaningfully GFC-dependent -- exactly the kind of single-crisis concentration ABSOLUTE_SCORER_SPEC §4.2 warns about needing a leave-one-bear-out gate for. It also fails a simple era-split (strong pre-2016, weak/wrong-signed post-2016) -- 2016-2024 was a period of persistent India market-cap/GDP re-rating (see the by-year proxy series: 71% in 2016 climbing steadily to 139% in 2024) where 'expensive-by-Buffett-standard' did NOT reliably precede weak forward returns, i.e. the market kept re-rating structurally rather than mean-reverting on the old schedule. That is a real, disclosable regime-dependency, not a data bug.
overall_verdict: BUILDABLE (both official-historical and live proxy, cross-validated r=0.965). Best-in-class CRASH-RISK signal among everything tested here, genuinely worth a place in the M/s_mkt design as a standalone conditioner -- but ship it with the GFC-concentration and era-split caveats stated explicitly, and do not average it away inside an unweighted ensemble (see W4MAC_ensemble_vs_valband card: blending dilutes this signal's crash-risk power from 0.489 down to 0.257-0.328).
confidence: MEDIUM-HIGH on the crash-risk finding (large gauge-vs-baseline gap, structurally sensible mechanism); MEDIUM on the return-prediction claim given the clean era-split failure -- state as directionally-right-but-regime-dependent, not a stable timing rule.
